Over the weekend, I sat down with the Central Virginia Health Services team. 

Thank you for answering my many questions — I learned a lot. 

This team provides medicine and healthcare screenings to over 47k people at 42 locations in #VA05. https://t.co/ZHpNAXXWrw

Our nation’s servicemembers deserve the highest standard of care. 

Last week, I sent a letter to the Defense Health Agency about the poor conditions and recent flooding incidents at Walter Reed.

I look forward to working with the DHA to fix this issue and return to high standards of care.

This Black History Month, I’d like to put a spotlight on the Buffalo Soldiers. They have had a major impact on U.S. history from 1866-1951, including World War I, World War II, and the Korean War.

Their efforts to protect this nation continue to play a vital role in the health and safety of everyday Americans. As a Veteran and Navy SEAL, I am grateful for their service.

I met with the Wounded Warrior Project team!

They are doing important work in mental health and suicide prevention for Veterans. Thank you for all you do! https://t.co/cgBGQbuA70

Today is the 106th birthday for the American Legion!

It was founded in 1919 by an Act of Congress following World War I. 

106 years later, they provide mental health support and fight to end veteran suicide. 

Thank you for all you do!

I met with the first responders here at the South Hill firestation in #VA05.

Their neighbors can sleep at night knowing they have this amazing team on their side. https://t.co/GffM3aGoXP

The team at the Kidney Dialysis Center in Amelia Court House, Virginia, performs lifesaving work every day for their community.

We had a thoughtful conversation about rural healthcare challenges and the steps Congress can take to address them. https://t.co/tA12pIDsgV

I had a fantastic tour of the UVA Medical Center and greatly appreciate their willingness to have important conversations about patient care, medical research, and healthcare reform.

They informed me of their “Earn While You Learn” program, which allows healthcare professionals to earn paychecks while they receive their education.
Nelson County’s Sheriff, Mark Embrey, does critical work to keep his neighbors safe. Thanks to him and his team, you can sleep at night! https://t.co/yYB1suNM5f
On National Nurses Day, it’s important to remember the healthcare providers on the front lines. Nurses are the backbone of our healthcare system. https://t.co/Ik1klqeeWN

I was happy to join the 43rd annual March of Dimes Gala with my wife, Tracy, and several fellow Lawmakers to support the fight for the health of all moms and babies.
 
Granny Polly’s Poundcake, our family recipe, was a huge hit! They raised 1.5 million dollars for their cause. https://t.co/kTu8mhbGV3

Last week, I had the privilege of touring the Johnson Health Center-Amherst County Community Health Center. It was great to learn about the Center's role in the community and the services they offer. We discussed the 340B Program, workforce development, and much more. https://t.co/PPHIUzERZG

Today commemorates the three-year anniversary of the Supreme Court’s decision in Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization. The Dobbs ruling rightfully overturned Roe v. Wade & affirmed that abortion is not a constitutional right. 

This decision was a momentous victory for life; however, our fight is not over until all women & unborn children are protected from the violence of abortion. Over 66 million abortions have occurred in the United States since 1973. 

I will continue the fight to protect & support expectant mothers & be a voice for the voiceless & most vulnerable, the unborn.

It was a true pleasure to join @DrOzCMS, Administrator of the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, for a thoughtful dinner conversation. 

We learned how Congress is assisting CMS in becoming more efficient through the One Big, Beautiful Bill, and discussed ways the agency can better serve the people of VA-05.

Years ago, I appeared on The Dr. Oz Show in New York City. Alongside one of my SEAL Team PT clients, we supported her on an inspiring journey—helping her lose 160 pounds, complete a half marathon, and win a national weight loss competition where her win was revealed on his show. It was a powerful reminder of what can be achieved through teamwork, dedication, and a relentless commitment to success!

Our warfighters sacrifice everything for our freedoms & we owe it to them to make sure they have support, not just on the battlefield, but at home. 

The FY26 NDAA invests in better pay, housing, & healthcare for military families. @HASCRepublicans are committed to those who serve.

In July, @HASCRepublicans passed the FY26 NDAA out of committee. This NDAA supports @POTUS’ Peace Through Strength agenda by funding next-gen weapons, invests in better pay, healthcare, housing for our military families, and rebuilds American military power, restores deterrence, and puts America first.

I am grateful for the leadership of Chairman @RepMikeRogersAL and I look forward to passing this critical legislation on the floor in the coming weeks.

I just wrapped up my meeting with VCU Children’s Hospital. We had a conversation on The Children’s Hospital of Richmond’s role in the 5th district and federal policy priorities related to children's hospitals and health care. Thank you for all you do to improve the lives of children!

Today, in @GOPoversight, I examined witnesses on how Make America Healthy Again strategies are improving the health of our Nation's Children.
Watch here👇 https://t.co/Lch6ZTZ8ph

Our troops deserve the best, not just on the battlefield, but at home. The #FY26NDAA invests in better pay, housing, healthcare, and support for military families. @HASCRepublicans and I committed to those who serve. https://t.co/p2Q5FYwaj6

Service doesn’t end with the uniform, it impacts families too. The #FY26NDAA invests billions to improve military housing, healthcare, & education for military  families. @HASCRepublicans & I stand with those who serve & those who support them! https://t.co/YTgEyOYl9Y

Today, I had a great meeting with VA-05 constituents from the American Association of Orthopedic Surgeons. We discussed burdensome prior authorization process, expansion of physician-led healthcare, and many other vital issues https://t.co/ywIXgz3oFu

The backbone of our Warfighters are those back home who support them. @HASCRepublicans and I made their support systems a priority! #FY26NDAA does this by investing BILLIONS in  
➡️ Improving military housing
➡️ Streamlining military healthcare 
➡️ Strengthening education for our military

I was honored to have the opportunity to participate in Bold Quest’s International Cyber Day. This vital exercise ensures the readiness of our cyber forces and interoperability with our allies and partners. Future conflicts will focus heavily on capabilities in cyberspace and as a member of @HASCRepublicans I am committed to ensuring that our military is ready to meet the threat.

Democrats are holding government funding hostage.  

Here are some of their ridiculous demands: 

➡️Restore taxpayer-funded healthcare for illegal aliens.

➡️Send half a billion dollars to leftist news outlets.

➡️Repeal the historic Working Families Tax Cut.

Clearly, Democrats would rather play partisan politics than keep the government open & working for the American people.
